evidence: The Alternative.me Fear & Greed Index dropped to 20 ('Extreme Fear') on the latest reading, down 4 points from 24 and well below both the 7-day average of 27.71 and the 30-day average of 33.03. Sentiment has remained depressed in the fear and extreme fear territory throughout the past week following a steep drop from 42 on November 3. While deep extreme fear can occasionally act as a contrarian indicator signaling oversold bounces, the persistent downward trajectory in sentiment over the past five days indicates sustained bearish pressure and elevated risk aversion in the short term. Accounting for the momentum of negative market sentiment and the strict tie-breaks-down rule, the probability of BTC closing higher over the 24-hour horizon is assessed slightly below even odds at 0.47.
limitations: The Fear & Greed Index is a composite sentiment metric and does not directly track spot order book depth, liquidity, or real-time intraday news catalysts.
Extreme fear conditions can precede both sharp relief rallies and prolonged capitulation phases.
Snapshot availability and later revisions are caller-attested, not independently verified.
